name: University of Saskatchewan
summary: Saskatoon university with 120+ programs, a green campus of greystone buildings and a synchrotron among its research facilities.

ib.text: Your Diploma total out of 45 (TOK and EE bonus points count) is converted to a percentage; each college sets a minimum total, 24 to 25, plus subject prerequisites, and some rank competitively.

dates.label: Agriculture, Arts and Science, Business: fall 2027 international deadline
Agriculture, Arts and Science, Business: fall 2027 documents due

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A redesigned first year with hands-on courses and tutorials in place of final exams, then one of eight accredited majors from chemical and civil to engineering physics. An optional co-op adds 4 to 20 months of paid work.
programmes.ib: Maths, Physics and Chemistry, each at grade 4 or above; entry is competitive and early admission asks for a higher total.

needs.note: Further Mathematics SL is also accepted

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on admission average. The stated minimum is 25; early admission asks for 33, and the 2026-27 target was 87% (30 points on USask's IB table).

flagshipSource.title: Engineering: a redesigned first year, eight accredited majors and an optional co-op internship

programmes.name: Agriculture and Bioresources
programmes.about: Degrees in agriculture, agribusiness, animal bioscience and food, with majors from crop science and agronomy to horticulture. The college has taught since 1912 and also offers two years of pre-veterinary study.
programmes.ib: Maths, Biology and Chemistry (Agribusiness: Maths and one science); one missing subject can be cleared before second year.
programmes.selectionNote: A minimum Diploma total of 24; applications are read until the deadline and offers go out on a rolling basis until the seats are full.

flagshipSource.title: College of Agriculture and Bioresources: degrees in agriculture, agribusiness, animal bioscience and food

faculties.name: Agriculture and Bioresources
faculties.line: Maths, Biology and Chemistry (Agribusiness: Maths and one science); a Diploma total of at least 24.

faculties.name: Arts and Science
faculties.line: Maths and a Diploma total of at least 24; Biomedical Sciences adds Biology, Chemistry and Physics, each at 4 or above.

faculties.name: Education
faculties.line: Maths, a science, History, English A and an extra language or fine art; two gaps can be cleared by second year. Total of 24.

faculties.name: Edwards School of Business
faculties.line: Maths and a Diploma total of at least 25; applications are read until the deadline and offered on a rolling basis.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Maths, Physics and Chemistry, each at 4 or above; competitive entry with a separate early-admission round.

faculties.name: Kinesiology
faculties.line: Maths, Biology, and Chemistry or Physics; stated totals of 25 for regular and 33 for early admission.

faculties.name: St. Thomas More College
faculties.line: Catholic college federated with USask, with about 240 liberal arts courses and BA programs in Philosophy and in Religion and Culture.

notes: USask converts your Diploma total to a percentage: 28 points is 85%, 33 is 90%, 24 is 79%; ask the admissions office how TOK and EE bonus points are added.
Deadlines differ by college: Engineering, Education and Kinesiology close in February, while Agriculture, Business and international Arts and Science applicants have until May.
Tuition is charged per class, so the published first-year figures are estimates for a full course load.
